aboutMe:
I'm a recent Computer Science graduate from the Singapore Institute of Technology, graduating with Honours with Distinction. I have an interest in mobile and cloud architecture, as well as backend systems. 

One project I'm particularly proud of is leading the development of a gamified step tracker application.I designed the overall system architecture, planned the technology stack, defined the database schema, and coordinated development by aligning tasks with each team member's strengths.
